sections.title: Colorado excise taxes on cigarettes and motor fuel

rows.label: Cigarette tax (per cigarette)
rows.note: State cigarette tax, 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2027. Rises to 13.2 cents per cigarette from 1 July 2027; modified risk tobacco products 7.2 cents. Sales tax also applies.

source.title: Cigarette Tax

rows.label: Motor fuel tax (per gallon of gasoline)
rows.note: State excise tax on gasoline and gasohol. A road usage fee also applies per gallon: $0.05 from July 2025 to June 2026, $0.06 from July 2026 to June 2027, plus smaller fees.

source.title: Fuel Tax Guide

rows.label: Motor fuel tax (per gallon of diesel fuel)
rows.note: State excise tax on diesel engine fuel. A road usage fee ($0.05 from July 2025, $0.06 from July 2026) and a bridge and tunnel impact fee ($0.07) also apply per gallon of special fuel.

source.title: Fuel Tax Guide
Cigarette Tax
